name: xbill
title: xbill
blurb: enter a handle and it downloads their entire bsky repo in one shot, then runs a live meter pricing that same fetch at X's read-API rate card ($5/1000 posts, $10/1000 profiles) — a dollar total that ticks up in real time as it walks the repo, next to what it actually cost on bsky: nothing. EXTRA mode finds every one of their moots (mutual follows) and bulk-fetches each moot's profile too, same running meter. META mode goes further: bulk-fetches a profile for every one of their follows and every one of their followers, not just the overlap. cee.wtf's idea, sent over by shimmermathlabs.com; EXTRA and META modes requested by shimmermathlabs.com.
